title: Puerto Madryn: the base for Valdés Peninsula
meta_description: Puerto Madryn guide: whales from shore, Punta Loma, diving, the Ecocentro and how to use it as a base for Valdés Peninsula.
hero_subtitle: A city on Golfo Nuevo, with whales in sight in season.
photo_alt: Puerto Madryn coastline on Golfo Nuevo

why_visit.title: Whales from shore
why_visit.text: In season, southern right whales come so close to some beaches in the gulf that you can see them without a boat.

why_visit.title: Base for Valdés Peninsula
why_visit.text: Most tours to the peninsula leave from the city.

why_visit.title: Welsh history
why_visit.text: Welsh settlers landed on this coast in 1865 and their legacy is still present in the region.

activities.title: Waterfront and beaches
activities.text: Several kilometers of waterfront for walking or cycling along the gulf.

activities.title: Whale watching from shore
activities.text: North of the city there are beaches where, in season, whales can be seen very close to shore.

activities.title: Punta Loma
activities.text: A nearby reserve with a sea lion colony and coastal viewpoints.

activities.title: Diving and snorkeling
activities.text: Golfo Nuevo's waters are a well-known diving destination, with trips for beginners and experienced divers.

activities.title: Ecocentro
activities.text: An interpretation center about the Patagonian sea, on a headland along the coast.

activities.title: Day trips
activities.text: From the city you can visit Valdés Peninsula, the Punta Tombo penguin colony in season and the Welsh towns of the Chubut valley.

how_to_get_there:
By plane: Puerto Madryn has an airport (PMY), and many travelers fly into Trelew (REL), about an hour away by road.

By bus: long-distance services run from Buenos Aires and other cities.

Getting around: tours with transfers or a rental car, very handy for exploring the peninsula at your own pace.

where_to_stay.budget: Hostels with shared rooms and guest kitchens, plus campsites in season. They're the most affordable option and a good place to meet other travelers.
where_to_stay.midrange: Inns, cabins and small hotels, often with breakfast included. Cabins with kitchens suit families and groups.
where_to_stay.luxury: Upscale hotels and lodges with landscape views, spas or tours included. Book them well in advance.

practical_tips.title: When to go
practical_tips.text: For whales, roughly June to December. In summer, the city is also a beach destination.

practical_tips.title: Changeable weather
practical_tips.text: Wind and sudden weather changes are part of the trip. Dress in layers and always carry a windbreaker.

practical_tips.title: Book ahead
practical_tips.text: In high season, lodging and tours fill up. It's best to book as soon as you have your dates.

practical_tips.title: Prices and payments
practical_tips.text: Prices change often: check current rates before you travel and carry some cash as well as cards.

closing: Puerto Madryn combines city, beach and wildlife. Three days let you explore the peninsula and enjoy the gulf.
